incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PDD-23488 fired for cluster gpu-west2a — metric cuda_alloc_failures > 50/min

pagerduty: Incident PDD-23488: triggered by alertmanager (rules/gpu/cuda_alloc)

maya: paging oncall, seeing 120 alloc failures across 6 nodes, spike started ~12:17 UTC

josh: acked PDD-23488 :white_check_mark:

maya: logs on one host:
```
E CudaAlloc: failed to allocate 2.3G (cudaErrorMemoryAllocation)
stack: at core/allocator.c:482
```

priya: is this the kvcache prefetch surge again? any kvcache evictions?

maya: yes eviction rate jumped, but these alloc failures happen even after evict attempts

leo: re-routed traffic from pool gpu-west2a -> gpu-west2b via router policy, traffic down to 30% of normal to the pool

ops-bot: reroute applied: route_id=r-14 -> to gpu-west2b, started=2026-03-15T12:22:10Z

josh: temp mitigation: enabling conservative allocator backoff on pool (cmd: `rictl pools update gpu-west2a --alloc-backoff=200ms`)

maya: running that now

maya: backoff applied, immediate failure rate dropped to ~15/min

priya: can we also disable prefetch on affected nodes? Suggest `kvcache.prefetch=false`

leo: on it, patching daemonset to toggle env

leo: patch rolled to 3/6 nodes so far

maya: customer impact: a subset of long-context jobs saw 502/timeout spikes, approx 4% of total requests for 3 customers (acme-inc, betaapp, demo-suite)

eva-support: customer acme-inc reported higher latencies, raising a support ticket. Notifying account team.

josh: adding temporary fallback model mapping for those customers to smaller quantized model: `fallback_map[acme-inc]=gpt-small-q4`

priya: monitoring metrics — mem pressure trending down but kernel alloc errors still appear intermittently

incident-bot: PagerDuty PDD-23488 acknowledged by josh at 2026-03-15T12:23:05Z

sre-rotation: i'm taking oncall handoff in 30m for post-mortem, leaving this open. ETA for full remediation 2-3 hours.

maya: note: we saw one node with GPU driver v.515 that had a slightly different stacktrace — possible driver interaction

leo: capturing crashdump and uploading to /var/logs/gpu-dumps/1791123456-node17.dmp

maya: next steps: continue traffic reroute, finish prefetch disable, collect dumps, consider rolling driver rollback to 512.x if reproduces

josh: i'll coordinate customer comms and keep escalation path to HW team ready

priya: adding eval check to detect regression post-fix

incident-bot: PDD-23488 status: acknowledged, responders: josh, maya, priya, leo

josh: handing off to sre-rotation for long tail; leaving notes in incident doc https://redwood.internal/incidents/PDD-23488

sre-rotation: ack, will run Dr. Repro script and follow up. :mag:
